scope: Go internal/cli flag tokenization and ordered validation; command inventory, help bytes, exit taxonomy and report schemas unchanged

design.core: internal/cli/flags.go: flagDefinition, flagSchema, parseCommandFlags and ordered flagRule validation
design.domainChecks: Remain command-owned and run in original token order before examining later flags or missing required flags.
design.terminator: Stable run/test retain command-owned -- splitting and program-argument validation.
design.atlasEvidence: Explicitly forwards unclaimed tokens individually and retains extraction-before-relation validation order.
design.unchangedSmallParsers: Fixed-arity positional parsing and the tiny optional --locked selector remain direct; the session JSON field decoder is not a CLI flag parser.

compatibilityOracle.baselineNote: Initial 24-parser snapshot captured before source edits. Valid around/evidence seeds expanded while their Atlas parsers were still unmodified, after stable/workspace comparisons passed.
compatibilityOracle.comparison: Full formatted option structs, including unexported fields, ordered slices, nil versus empty slices, defaults, and exact error strings.
compatibilityOracle.corpus: Per-flag values, repeated/missing arguments, valid command seeds and token mutations, 512 flag-presence combinations, and 1500 deterministic random sequences per parser (PCG seeds 3 and 7).
compatibilityOracle.temporaryArtifacts: Baseline/current snapshots and generator retained only in ignored .cache/cli-flags-refactor; temporary oracle test removed from source after comparison.

checks.note: Repeated after each migrated command family; final augmented snapshot bytes match the corresponding pre-migration oracle.

checks.coverage: Parser domains, required/duplicate flags, delimiter and NUL handling, native and semantic tests, exact/package/file/directory selection, JSON, stdin, capture and canonical timeout options.
11 public RunWithInput failures assert numeric exit 2, empty stdout and exact stderr prefix/message/blank-line/help envelope.

checks.note: Repository-wide package compilation only; not a claim of full-suite execution.

notRun.check: Full repository and full CLI native suites
notRun.reason: Focused affected-command suites, deterministic parser comparison and repository-wide compilation cover the refactor; unrelated compiler/native workloads were not repeated.

notRun.check: Candidate CLI bootstrap rebuild and full candidate/Go comparison
notRun.reason: Only Go CLI parser internals changed; candidate sources and public CLI contracts are unchanged.
No quantitative latency or allocation claim.
